sources.title: UCAS 2027 Entry Dates & Deadlines
sources.last_excerpt:
Dates and deadlines for uni applications | UCAS 
 Skip navigation 
 2027 entry application deadlines
 For courses starting in 2027 (and for deferred applications ), your application should be with us at UCAS by one of these dates – depending on what courses you apply for. If your completed application – including all your personal details and your academic reference – is submitted by the deadline, it is guaranteed to be considered.
 If you're applying through your school/college, please check their deadline, and follow this to get your application in on time . This gives them enough time to read your application, check you've entered your qualifications correctly, write and attach your reference, and submit your application to us.
 Check course information in our search tool to see which deadline applies to you.

 Admission Services
 Apply to Bachelor's programmes in English
 At Aalto University, you can study in bachelor’s programmes in English in the fields of business and economics, science and technology as well as art and design. The next application period for programmes taught in English is 7–22 January 2027. On this website, you'll find the descriptions and application guidelines for all Aalto's bachelor's programmes in English. You will also find information on student admissions and experiences of studying at Aalto!
 How you benefit from our programmes
 As an Aalto student, you'll enjoy the benefits offered by the programmes and Aalto University:
 Innovative, future-oriented programmes.
 Aalto's unique combination of fields - combine business, art and technology in your studies!
 State-of-the-art faculty. Teaching based on top-notch research and real-world applications.
 International career opportunities and degrees valued by employers.
 Tight industry relations and a thriving startup ecosystem.
 Main campus in the vibrant Helsinki capital region.
